# Vinod Kumaran — AI Visibility Strategist

> Building the next layer of digital visibility. Where high intent meets AI visibility.

## About

Vinod Kumaran is a digital strategist and AEO/GEO pioneer with 17+ years of experience in organic search, AEO, content and growth systems. One of the top pioneers adapting and executing AEO projects. He helps complex brands become visible, relevant and discoverable across AI-powered search experiences — ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity.

Based in India, working globally.

## Expertise

- **Organic SEO & AEO**: Organic SEO, AEO, Keyword Strategy, Query Optimization, Content Structure, Entity Mapping
- **Search**: SEO, Search Intent, Content Strategy, Technical SEO, Entities
- **AI Visibility**: AEO, GEO, Generative Search, AI Citations, Prompt Strategy
- **Growth Systems**: CRM, Automation, Attribution, Lead Management, Infrastructure

## Services

- Organic SEO/AEO improvement for keywords and queries
- GEO/AEO and AI Citation Setup for your brand
- One of the top pioneers adapting and executing AEO projects

## The Vinod Kumaran Visibility Framework

1. Intent — Understand what high-value audiences are asking
2. Content — Build the information required to answer those questions
3. Entity — Establish the brand and its expertise clearly
4. Authority — Build credible signals across the digital ecosystem
5. AI Visibility — Become discoverable across AI-powered experiences
6. Impact — Connect visibility with measurable business outcomes
